hero.lede: Qiskit Fall Fest is a global celebration of quantum computing, where the community comes together to learn, build, and explore the future of quantum technology.

whatIsFest.heading: What is Qiskit Fall Fest?
whatIsFest.body: Qiskit Fall Fest is a global series of local events hosted by the Qiskit community to celebrate quantum computing. Each chapter brings together students, developers, researchers, educators, and industry experts to share knowledge, work on hands-on projects, and build the quantum future.

theme.label: 2026 Theme
theme.title: A Decade of Quantum on the Cloud
theme.body: Ten years ago, IBM made quantum computing available on the cloud for the first time. In 2026, we celebrate a decade of innovation, accessibility, and community-driven progress in quantum computing.

whatIsQiskit.heading: What is Qiskit?
whatIsQiskit.body: Qiskit is an open-source framework developed by IBM for working with quantum computers. It enables you to create, run, and optimize quantum programs using Python.

features.title: End-to-End
features.description: From education to research to industry

whatIsQiskit.codeSample:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator

qc = QuantumCircuit(2, 2)
qc.h(0)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.measure([0, 1], [0, 1])

backend = AerSimulator()
job = backend.run(transpile(qc, backend), shots=1024)
result = job.result()
print(result.get_counts())

localEvent.heading: About Our Local Event
localEvent.body: This local Qiskit Fall Fest 2026 event brings together the quantum community at our university and beyond. It aims to inspire curiosity, encourage learning, and provide a platform to collaborate on the next wave of quantum innovation.
objectives: Promote quantum computing education and awareness
Provide hands-on experience with Qiskit and quantum systems
Foster collaboration among students, researchers, and industry
Encourage innovation through challenges and team activities
Connect with the global Qiskit community

cards.title: Who Should Attend?
cards.body: Students, developers, researchers, educators, professionals, and anyone curious about quantum computing — no prior quantum experience required!

cards.title: Why It Matters?
cards.body: Quantum computing is transforming the future — from solving complex problems to building new industries. Be part of this journey and help shape what's next.
